sloka: तस्य रामेण विद्धस्य सहसा ऽभिप्रधावतः।अङ्गारमित्राः क्रुद्धस्य मुखान्निश्चेरुरर्चिषः ।। ६.६७.१०६ ।।
transliteration: tasya rāmeṇa viddhasya sahasā 'bhipradhāvataḥ।aṅgāramitrāḥ kruddhasya mukhānniścerurarciṣaḥ ।। 6.67.106 ।।

translations.english: Adorned with golden ornaments (Kumbhakarna), covered with darts without being tormented he looked like a dark mountain shining like sun rays covered by clouds.
